errors.text_span: 蓝色实线带圆形标记代表500维，橙色实线带圆形标记代表300维，灰色实线带圆形标记代表200维，黄色实线带圆形标记代表100维
errors.evidence: The figure’s legend indicates the lines are colored blue, orange, gray, and yellow, but the reference states the marker shapes differ by series (500维圆形, 300维方形, 200维菱形, 100维三角形). The machine description incorrectly assigns circular markers to all four series.

These series values do not match the plotted lines. For example, at “词2n” the blue series is about 0.95 but orange/gray are closer to about 0.94/0.89 and yellow about 0.84; at “标点2n” the blue series is around 0.91–0.92, not 0.90, and the yellow series is about 0.92, not 0.95. Several other listed values are similarly off.
The yellow 100维 value at “词” is closer to about 0.95–0.96, but the blue/orange/gray values are slightly off from the plotted points (roughly 0.91, 0.93, 0.92).

errors.text_span: 其中100维在“词”类别处达到最高点0.96，500维在“词2n”类别处达到0.95，随后在“词类2n”类别处下降至0.8，之后回升至“标点2n”类别处的0.9
errors.evidence: The 100维 line does peak near 0.95–0.96 at “词”, and 500维 drops to about 0.8 at “词类2n”, but its final value at “标点2n” is slightly above 0.9, closer to about 0.91–0.92.
